title: BassiTech, an Abuja consultancy, points to a 12-week AI skills programme for 100 young people

claims.text: BassiTech Solutions describes itself as an Abuja-based technology consulting company offering strategy, software, proposals and digital skills.
The company says it serves businesses and organisations in fintech, telecoms, agriculture and media.
BassiTech says its Digital Wings Initiative is an AI-focused digital skills programme in Taraba State.
The programme is designed for 100 young people.
claims.label: Programme participants

claims.text: The company says it has designed 2 farming programmes for Kudan LGA.
claims.label: Programmes for Kudan LGA

claims.text: The site lists 5 projects and ventures in its case studies.
claims.label: Projects featured

claims.text: BassiTech says it is led by founder Anas Abubakar Bassi, a Computer Engineer who studied at Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria.
